edit.title: Maintain business curation
edit.description: One submission atomically replaces the complete business metadata, semantic links, and responsibilities. Every cross-module ID is resolved exactly by its fact owner.
edit.recommendedSuccessorPlaceholder: Search active curated or certified catalog entries
edit.recommendedSuccessorHint: Guide users to another enterprise resource without merging the two catalog identities.
edit.invalidSuccessor: The recommended successor must be a canonical CatalogEntry UUID
edit.componentElementHint: Enter a Standard element ID for an active component; leave it empty for no element link.
edit.exactIdHint: The first release uses stable owner IDs and validates them exactly in the current tenant on submission.
edit.ownerDomainHint: The primary domain is owned by {module} and can only be changed there. Catalog maintains secondary domains only.
edit.responsibilityHint: Department and User both use stable System IDs; a User must have an active membership in the current tenant.
edit.conflict: Another operation has updated this entry. This form will not overwrite the newer version automatically.
edit.invalidId: Every reference ID must be a positive decimal integer without leading zeros
edit.duplicateReference: The same semantic reference cannot be repeated
edit.multiplePrimaryDomains: A catalog entry can have at most one primary domain
edit.curationIncomplete: Curated and later states require a business name and description, an effective primary domain declared by the owner, one accountable department, one business owner, and at least one data steward
edit.deprecationReasonRequired: A reason is required to deprecate a catalog entry
